#### Describe the bug

----------------------------------------------

```
r-goto@Mac:1.r-goto_admin +[master]%chef -v
Chef Workstation version: 20.8.125
Chef Infra Client version: 16.4.38
Chef InSpec version: 4.22.8
Chef CLI version: 3.0.24
Chef Habitat version: 1.6.56
Test Kitchen version: 2.6.0
Cookstyle version: 6.15.5
```

```
[vagrant@localhost /]$ ls /Users
ls: cannot access Users: no such directory
```

After `knife bootstrap`:

```
[vagrant@localhost /]$ ls /Users/r-goto/.chef/cache/chef-client-running.pid 
Users/r-goto/.chef/cache/chef-client-running.pid
```

`knife bootstrap` is creating chef directory right under `root` directory, which is not acceptable.
How can we change the directory location and where is it recommended to place?

it seems that by default `cache_path` picking up workstation home dir instead of node home dir

```
> cat /etc/chef/client.rb 

chef_server_url  "https://chef-server.test/organizations/4thcoffee"
validation_client_name "4thcoffee-validator"
chef_license "accept"
log_location   STDOUT
node_name "node2.test"
trusted_certs_dir "/etc/chef/trusted_certs"
file_cache_path "/home/vivek.singh/.chef/cache"  # workstion home dir /home/vivek.singh
file_backup_path "/home/vivek.singh/.chef/backup"

```

Adding these lines in the `knife.rb` will place the `Users` directory where it's used to be.  

```
file_cache_path "/var/chef/cache"
file_backup_path "/var/chef/backup"
```

Could this be a workaround for this bug? 
Could this change cause any impact after fix release?

--

Also for those already bootstrapped and `Users`/ already placed under /, is it okay to relocate the directory to any intended location manually or should those nodes be bootstrapped again with above lines in `knife.rb`?

Hi @r-goto 

> Could this be a workaround for this bug?

_Yes, it will be a workaround. the problem only arises when `file_cache_path` and `file_backup_path`
taking default values._

> Could this change cause any impact after fix release?

_Nothing to worry, as the fixes only taking consideration when `file_cache_path` and `file_backup_path` are not set._


> Also for those already bootstrapped and Users/ already placed under /, is it okay to relocate the directory to any intended location manually or should those nodes be bootstrapped again with the above lines in knife.rb?

_Manually moving to any intended location probably will work, if the node's `/etc/chef/client.rb` file gets updated accordingly._

So please update `/etc/chef/client.rb` with:

```
file_cache_path "/var/chef/cache"
file_backup_path "/var/chef/backup"

```

I am running into this same issue.

All I did was update my Chef Workstation and now these two values are getting set in my `client.rb` file on each node I bootstrap. This is **not** in my config.rb and I consider this a very bad bug. If this is not specified it needs to be left out on nodes being bootstrapped.

I found a workaround, by setting this in my `.chef/knife.rb` file:

```
file_cache_path nil
file_backup_path nil
```

If that helps anyone else, and possibly for @r-goto0510 on the "windows" machine.

For me, this made the lines not get added to `/etc/chef/client.rb` as was the previous results.

It's obviously not the best, would be great to have the fix but in the meantime here's another work around is to use knife bootstrap templates (https://docs.chef.io/workstation/knife_bootstrap/#custom-templates).

From the doc you would run something like this on mac, this will pull the default bootstrap template for nix to a file template.erb

```
find /opt/chef-workstation/embedded/lib/ruby -type f -name chef-full.erb -exec cat {} \; > template.erb
```

This will pull the default for the windows to a win-template.erb

```
find /opt/chef-workstation/embedded/lib/ruby -type f -name windows-chef-client-msi.erb -exec cat {} \; > win-template.erb
```

The idea here is using the bootstrap template to remove the offending values. Running something like this `sed` to strip out the `file_cache_path` and `file_backup_path`. Alternatively instead of replacing with `''` (empty string) you could replace it with the platform specific value you're looking for.

```
sed -i "s/config_content/config_content.gsub(\/(file_cache_path *.+)\/, '').gsub(\/(file_backup_path *.+)\/, '').strip/g" template.erb
```

There is one additional step required for windows, currently the knife_config isn't available so we just clear it out in the second `sed`

```
sed -i "s/config_content/config_content.gsub(\/(file_cache_path *.+)\/, '').gsub(\/(file_backup_path *.+)\/, '').strip/g" win-template.erb
sed -i "s/knife_config//g" win-template.erb
```

Finally, adding another flag to the bootstrap command `--bootstrap-template template.erb`, preserving the `template.erb` for subsequent bootstraps or moving it into your knife config so you don't have to worry about it any more (until the fix is released).

This is only an example of how we are using train helpers `ChefUtiles.file_exist?` which hitting the node to check whether the dir exists or not.

Ref: https://github.com/chef/chef/blob/fb4197f19f60740780c35f4ff37adbd493fdb2dc/chef-utils/lib/chef-utils/dsl/train_helpers.rb#L37-L43

- As run context denoting the chef-client run and have ohai node object in place to respond query node info like platform etc.

- Here we have added bootstrap_context which denoting we have actively made connection to the node able to answer query about the node using train transport connection.

This likely isn't the right way to do this for knife.  Chef has to do this because we support calling the DSL methods from library files where we don't have any kind of useful context or DSL so need to use the Chef.run_context to get at the state of the chef-client run.  That itself is probably a bad idea because it isn't threadsafe.  What should be done here is that under lib/chef/knife there should be a mixin created which pulls in the train_helpers and wires up the transport_connection similarly to lib/ohai/mixin/train_helpers.rb in https://github.com/chef/ohai/pull/1503/files
Pending to wire this for windows bootstrap context
